artDirection.style: premium cohesive tropical anime/chibi, organic silhouettes, fluid fabric, nuanced shading
artDirection.geometry: NOT rectangles, tubes, toy mannequin limbs, or circular shoulder plugs
artDirection.pose: full-body standing master image for each direction; clothing, hair, proportions match approved identity
artDirection.proportion: one consistent head/body scale across all views and both characters; avoid oversized pasted face with narrow rectangular neck and blocky trunk
artDirection.boneBinding: all arms and legs consist of 2 bone segments each with separate wrist/ankle cap; one single anatomical limb per side
disallowed: pasting a small pixelated static avatar head over generic geometry
painting polygonal clothing on top of stroke-only limbs
static artwork already containing hands/arms under separate moving arms
cutting the full-body still photo into uncontrolled overlapping masks
making visual or deployment success claims from unit tests alone

rendering: split master artwork into transparent layers whose boundaries overlap only under joint seams
set anchors on shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee and ankle from approved skeleton
draw each anatomical layer exactly once; never draw an original static full-body image underneath
validate seam continuity at all action extremes and front, left, right and back
render and review 9 actions x 4 views x 2 characters on Player Web
obtain owner's visual approval before integration into main gameplay
